name: cascade-market
description: Research markets, evaluate opportunities, design decision-grade experiments, and create evidence-backed positioning and messaging without converting synthetic actors into market proof.

interface.shortDescription: Research markets and shape evidence-backed positioning.
interface.longDescription: Build current source ledgers for pains, segments, competitors, alternatives, economics, and constraints; assess opportunities; design experiments; and turn accepted evidence into positioning, messaging, naming, tone, proof, and trust language without inventing market claims.
defaultPrompt: Research this market with a current evidence ledger.
Evaluate this market opportunity or design a bounded validation experiment.
Create evidence-backed positioning and messaging for this product.
